_comment: Served straight from Vercel at /android-latest.json. The APK's native Updater reads it (via the same-origin fetch in src/lib/appUpdate.ts) and compares versionCode for its own applicationId. APK files live in /public/apps. Keep versionCode in sync with android/app/build.gradle. See docs/APP_UPDATES.md.
